maxRps.rationale: No explicit gateway limit stated; set slightly above current 500 rps load to reflect a typical headroom ceiling rather than an exact stated cap.

instances.rationale: Prose states requests go through 8 instances of the order service.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: No concurrency figure given; assume a typical moderate per-instance concurrency for a service doing synchronous downstream calls (payment + DB write).

serviceTimeMs.rationale: No explicit CPU/IO time given for validation logic itself (excluding downstream calls); assume a typical lightweight validation time.

instances.rationale: Modeled as a single logical external dependency since it's a third-party synchronous call, not a horizontally-scaled internal service we control.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: External payment providers typically cap concurrent in-flight calls per client; assume a typical moderate limit since none was stated.

serviceTimeMs.rationale: No latency given for the payment provider call; assume a typical external payment gateway round-trip time.

connectionPoolSize.rationale: Prose states Postgres connections are unpooled and capped at 40 connections.

queryTimeMs.rationale: No query time stated; assume a typical write query latency for an order insert on Postgres.

writeRatio.rationale: Prose states almost all traffic is writes (placing new orders), not reads.

readReplicas.rationale: Prose states two read replicas run off the primary.

replicaApplyRate.rationale: No sustained replica apply rate given; assume a typical value sufficient to keep pace with a write-heavy 500 rps workload without stated evidence of lag.
